content: Aburɑmu kɑ win kurɔ Sɑɑrɑi bɑ ǹ bii mɑrɑ. Wee Sɑɑrɑi wi, u yoo tɔn kurɔ ɡoo mɔ wi u sɑ̃ɑ Eɡibitiɡii. Win yĩsirɑ Aɡɑɑ.
Mɑ Sɑɑrɑi u win durɔ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wee, Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑn kuɑ wĩro. Nɑ nun kɑnɑmɔ, ɑ kɑ nɛn yoo duo. Sɔrɔkudo kon bibu wɑ sɑɑ win min di. M ɑ Aburɑmu u win kurɔn ɡɑri wurɑ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Sɑɑrɑi u win yoo Aɡɑɑ wi suɑ u win durɔ kɑ̃ kurɔ. N deemɑ bɑ wɔ̃ɔ wɔkuru kuɑ kɔ Kɑnɑnin temɔ.
Mɑ Aburɑmu u kɑ Aɡɑɑ mɛnnɑ mɑ Aɡɑɑ u ɡurɑ suɑ. Ye u wɑ u ɡurɑ mɔ, yerɑ u win yinni Sɑɑrɑi ɡɛndu wɔri.
Mɑ Sɑɑrɑi u Aburɑmu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn wɔmburu tu wɔri wunɛ sɔɔ. Nɑ nun nɛn yoo kɑ̃ kurɔ, ɑdɑmɑ ye u wɑ mɑ u ɡurɑ mɔ, yerɑ u mɑn ɡɛndu wɔri. Yinni Gusunɔwɑ koo sun siriɑ nɛ kɑ wunɛ.
Aburɑmu u Sɑɑrɑi wisɑ u nɛɛ, wunɑ ɑ wunɛn yoo mɔ, ɑ kɑ nùn koowo nɡe mɛ ɑ kĩ. Sɑɑ yerɑ u Aɡɑɑ nɔni mɛni mɑ Aɡɑɑ u dukɑ suɑ win min di.
u nùn wɑ ɡbɑburɔ bwiɑ ɡɑɑn bɔkuɔ Surin swɑɑɔ.
U nɛɛ, Aɡɑɑ, Sɑɑrɑin yoo, mɑn diyɑ ɑ wee. Mɑnɑ ɑ dɔɔ. Aɡɑɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ dukɑ suɔwɑ nɛn yinni Sɑɑrɑin min di.
Mɑ ɡɔrɑdo wi, u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ɡɔsiro wunɛn yinnin mi, kpɑ ɑ nùn wiru kpĩiyɑ.
Kon wunɛn bweseru dɑbiɑsiɑ sere ɡoo kun kpɛ̃ u tu ɡɑri.
Wee ɑ ɡurɑ mɔ, kɑɑ bii tɔn durɔ mɑ kpɑ ɑ nùn yĩsiru kɛ̃ Isimɛɛli. Domi Yinni Gusunɔ u wunɛn nɔɔ nuɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑ te sɔɔ.
Bii wi, u ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe kɛtɛku ɡbeeku. U ko n kɑ tɔmbu kpuro nɔɔ ɡɔmunu mɔ̀. Tɔmbu kpuro bɑ koo mɑɑ kɑ nùn nɔɔ ɡɔmunu ko. U ko n kɑ win dusibu tondinɛ.
Ye Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ Aɡɑɑ ɡɑri yi kuɑ u kpɑ, mɑ Aɡɑɑ u nùn yĩsiru kɑ̃ u nɛɛ, wunɑ Yinni wi u wɑɑmɔ. Domi u tii bikiɑ u nɛɛ, kɑ ɡem nɑ Gusunɔ wɑ kɑ nɔni, mɑ nɑ wɑ̃ɑ nɑ ǹ ɡu?
Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ dɔkɔ ye sokɑ Gusunɔ u mɑn wɑɑmɔ. Dɔkɔ ye, yɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ Kɑdɛsi kɑ Bɑrɛdin bɑɑ sɔɔ.
Yen biru Aɡɑɑ u Aburɑmu bii tɔn durɔ mɑruɑ, mɑ Aburɑmu u bii wi yĩsiru kɑ̃ Isimɛɛli.
Aburɑmun wɔ̃ɔ ɡɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɛnɛ kɑ nɔɔbɑ tiɑ sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ Isimɛɛli mɑrɑ.
Bɑnɡo sɑ̃ɑwɑ Gusunɔn ɑrukɑwɑni yen yĩreru

footnotes.text: Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo - Isirelibɑ bɑ ku rɑ kɑ̃ bu Gusunɔn yĩsiru siɑ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ ù n bu kuremɑ bɑ rɑ nɛɛ, Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdowɑ.
